# Project Governance

Governance version: GOV-1

## Authority and precedence

Applicable law and stronger security controls take precedence. Explicit user decisions retain authority over product intent unless either higher authority conflicts.

## Principles

### GOV-001 - Preserve approved retention policy

Classification: MUST
Authority: Product owner
Rationale: Retention is an approved product constraint.

## Amendment process

Amendments require a version, authority, rationale, date, and affected principle IDs.

## Authorized exceptions

### EXC-001

Principle: GOV-001
Authorized by: Product owner
Authority basis: Explicit user decision DEC-009
Rationale: A legal preservation request requires a temporary retention extension.
Review condition: Review when request closes.
